node.title: Re: Executing program with arguments from cgi script
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I need to run ffmpeg from a CGI script, of course with arguments

This is a very dangerous thing to do. See [id://1180578] for why, and for some modules that you could use to make the risk smaller. Assuming this is on a *NIX system, at the very least, you must use the [doc://system|system LIST] form, for example system($ffmpeg,'-i',$video,'-i',$watermark,...), and you should additionally validate the variables you're passing to the command.

Nothing works.

I suspect there is an error happening that you're not seeing. See the documentation of [doc://system] on how to check for errors; the same advice from that documentation on inspecting [doc://$?] applies to backticks as well.
